github_issue_closed_trigger.description: Runs when an issue in a GitHub repository is closed, whether completed or closed as not planned, and again if it's reopened and closed later. Issues already closed when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.owner: Beta. The user or organization that owns the repository, so a step that comments on or labels this issue can use @issue.owner instead of asking for the repository again.
output.repo: Beta. The repository the issue is in, to go with owner.

output.title: string

github_pull_request_merged_trigger.description: Runs when a pull request in a GitHub repository is merged, with its title, description, labels and who merged it. Each pull request starts one run. Pull requests closed without merging, or already merged when the workflow is turned on, don't start it.

output.base: The branch it was merged into.
output.body: The pull request's description, as its author wrote it.
output.draft: Whether it was a draft. Always false once merged.
output.head: The branch its changes came from.
output.html_url: The pull request's page on GitHub.
output.labels: The names of the pull request's labels, such as bug.
output.merged_by: Who merged it (their GitHub username), or blank if GitHub couldn't say.
output.owner: The user or organization that owns the repository.
output.repo: The repository the pull request is in.
output.state: closed, as for every merged pull request.
output.title: The pull request's title.
output.user: Who opened the pull request (their GitHub username).
